method: Reconstruct security closures from immutable evidence, review findings, remediation ordering, exact-candidate gates and control-plane chronology. Receipts index evidence but are not sole proof. Stale ACTIVE/EN_PROGRESO is corrected without fabricating closure.

cross_stage_corrections.verdict: COLA start/update metadata predates N8.7.D closure, but immutable receipts establish D closed 2026-09-15T21:06:20Z then E closed 2026-09-15T21:08:20Z with dependency satisfied. No reopen.

items.verdict: No remediable security/observability defect was proven before controlled performance evidence; the security stage did not pretend benchmark coverage and deferred load conclusions to G. Sheet timestamps around E/F are stale telemetry, not causal receipt chronology.
Provider backup boundary introduced no application secret/authz/schema surface requiring a new security change; controls remained provider/operator scoped and restore validation stayed deferred.
Security audit closed only after directed backend/frontend/security gates with P0/P1/P2=0 and no unresolved bypass or secret exposure.
Old EN_PROGRESO/ACTIVE marker belonged to an ended invocation and had no N8.12.F closure receipt/review. COLA was safely reconciled to PENDIENTE; no PASS or LISTO inferred.

Security baseline maps JWT/authn/authz, backend RBAC/tenant authority, audit/logging/health, PII/secret rules and client-guard non-authority with REVIEW_FIRST P0=0/P1=0. N8.15 macro certification later validates the same baseline without inventing a retroactive F receipt.

Mandatory authn/authz/RBAC/tenant/audit/PII/secret/redaction/rate-limit/CORS/trust-boundary/security-test fields were made explicit with REVIEW_FIRST P0=0/P1=0; macro matrix governance later certifies the contract lifecycle.

REVIEW_FIRST detected a real P1 static/demo bearer persistence issue and P2 stale public-route auth model; both were repaired same-run before final closure, post-fix review reached P0/P1/P2=0, and exact-head matrix security/backend gates passed.

Tenant scope, RBAC, auditability, secrets/config and narrowed fail-closed navigation were reviewed with P0/P1/P2=0; exact functional candidate c0d453957... passed causal ERP N1.1, N1.2, dependency-security and integrated M9 gates. The only observed RBAC workflow failure was an unrelated EF snapshot step and explicitly non-causal.
